intro: How your business looks to the people you deal with: your logo, colours and fonts, and how invoices, emails, labels and online shops use them. A change here is a draft until it is published, so nothing customers see moves by accident.
start: Set your brand in Studio › Brand: the logo, the colours and the details at the foot of every document.
Publish it, so emails and documents use it.
Open Documents and check how your invoice looks with the new brand.
Look at Message templates, and change the words of the emails you send most.
